sources.articleTitle: NERC okays N30bn to meter Band A customers

headline: Nigerian Regulatory Commission Approves N30 Billion Meter Funding
seoTitle: NERC Approves N30 Billion For Electricity Meters
metaDescription: The Nigerian Electricity Regulatory Commission has authorized N30 billion in funding to supply free meters to Band A and select Band B customers.
aiSummaryBullets: The Nigerian Electricity Regulatory Commission authorized N30 billion for new electricity meters.
The initiative focuses on providing equipment at no cost to unmetered consumers.
The funding is designated for customers categorized under Band A and certain Band B designations.
aiContextParagraph: The Nigerian Electricity Regulatory Commission (NERC) has formally approved a financial allocation of N30 billion aimed at addressing infrastructure gaps in the nation's power sector. This funding is specifically directed toward the procurement and distribution of free electricity meters for households that currently lack metering hardware. According to the regulatory body, the program targets customers classified within Band A, which generally represents higher-usage consumers, as well as specific segments within Band B. This action serves as an intervention to improve billing transparency and management for these consumer groups. By providing these meters at no charge, the commission intends to mitigate issues associated with estimated billing practices. While further implementation details regarding the rollout schedule have not been disclosed, this capital injection represents a significant effort by the regulatory authority to stabilize service delivery and enhance consumer satisfaction across identified power distribution bands.
